ROT.primitive: range of the smoothed minimum-area-rectangle orientation over the sequence, degrees

satsot.reason: no oriented geometry in the source (horizontal boxes only), so the primitive cannot be measured

IV.primitive_description: range of the frame-level median intensity over the sequence, relative to its median

BC.primitive_description: target contrast relative to its neighbourhood's contrast

SOB.primitive_description: strongest normalised cross-correlation of the target template elsewhere within 2.5x the object size
